verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Rootly serves an llms.txt at docs.rootly.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured product summary. Its docs are also served as markdown (.md) pages, such as help-and-documentation.md and the on-call pages, which agents can ingest directly. missing for 10: no llms-full.txt or first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering, no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Rootly documentation: set up on-call and alerting, run incidents, publish status pages, and learn from retrospectives, with AI throughout every step.
